basics.name: Karthickpranav S N
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Engineer, three years in, most of it in fintech. I do my best work when I can pick something up and own it end to end, given room to decide how. My favourite work ships nothing a user will ever see and makes every engineer around me faster: build and compile times, CI, shared templates, automation, internal tooling.

work.name: Nium
highlights: Joined through Nium's acquisition of Cypher, continuing on payments infrastructure.

work.name: Cypher
highlights: Rebuilt CI/CD. Pre-commit went from unusable to 8 seconds, CI from 17 minutes to 5, tests from 10 minutes to 90 seconds. The team stopped reaching for --no-verify.

Modernized the stack in every repo I touched: Vite for create-react-app and webpack, Bun for Node, Biome for ESLint and Prettier, viem for ethers. Installs, builds and static analysis fell from minutes to milliseconds, up to 50x in places.
Audited the internal ledger against payment providers and closed it out, taking hundreds of thousands of inconsistencies to zero unknowns, each one categorized by root cause.
Built the marketing site solo, from design handoff to launch. Astro, AI-scaled page generation, SEO, accessibility, LLM crawlability.

work.name: Stealth DeFi Protocol
highlights: Built the frontend template the company now copies into all of its frontends, and spent the time to make it something the next engineer would not curse me for.
Shipped smart contract integrations in user-facing apps, rewrote the internal dashboard nobody asked for and everyone needed, and ran user research in Indonesia.
Joined after contributing anonymously for two months. First remote role, so I over-communicated on purpose and nobody had to guess what I was on.

work.name: Cypher Wallet (YC W22)
highlights: Owned and shipped React Native features for the mobile app, and part of the React dapp.
Built an internal tool on Next.js 13 and set up transactional email with React Email and AWS SES.
First Web3 role. Learned the space by working in it.
